shortDescription: India's wholesale prices (INWPI=ECI) rose 11.39% year-on-year in September after a 9.92% rise in the previous month, government data showed on Wednesday.Economists polled by Reuters had projected wholesale prices to rise 10.18% year-on-year.

children: India's wholesale prices (INWPI=ECI) rose 11.39% year-on-year in September after a 9.92% rise in the previous month, government data showed on Wednesday.
Economists polled by Reuters had projected wholesale prices to rise 10.18% year-on-year.
